raw_record.question_text: In right triangle $ABC$ shown below, what is the measure of $\angle A$ to the nearest tenth of a degree?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: triangle ABC is right-angled at C, side AB is the slanted hypotenuse labeled 35, and side CB is the horizontal leg labeled 22. The question asks for angle A. Relative to angle A, CB is the opposite side and AB is the hypotenuse, so use the sine ratio: sin(A)=opposite/hypotenuse=22/35. Compute A=arcsin(22/35), then round the result to the nearest tenth of a degree to get 38.9 degrees.

推理：相对于∠A，边CB是对边，AB是斜边。因此使用正弦比：sin(A)=对边/斜边=22/35。计算A=arcsin(22/35)≈38.9447°，四舍五入到最接近的十分之一度为38.9°。
